you_are_here: ENGAGEMENT CLOSED 31 July 2026; this is a post-close session. The last owed build is DONE — 16.3 recall simplified to four optional ANDed fields (Client Name, Position, Label, Search ID); scope selector, consultant picker and date range removed; same filename, no backend change, 20.3 untouched. Two client-agreed items were deliberately overridden: Label stays in recall, and Shalini's client+position pairing requirement is gone (98 rows 147-148). 16.2.2 stays preserved on Amit's call and now diverges from 16.3 on recall. New: doc 27, a Usage & Utilisation review over the search log (24-31 Jul, 20 rows, 6 consultants) — adoption of everything shipped 29-30 Jul is COMPLETE, but cross-consultant reuse has never happened once. 27 is committed to the Ishwa repo unlinked and goes to Shalini by private link; no password gate is possible on static hosting. A monthly reporting product is scoped but not built. Pricing remains unbilled.

key_decisions.rationale: Recall exists so a different consultant can find prior work; that person rarely has both the account and the exact title. The pairing requirement locked out the user the feature was built for.

key_decisions.decision: Engagement closed on the Sourcing Assistant (31 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: 16.3 is the delivered product. Validated unprompted by the client on the closing call.

key_decisions.decision: Rubric Build removed as a deliverable (31 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: Phase 4 never taken up — walkthrough session never ran, rubric v1 never signed off. Removed rather than carried as permanently pending. 13A and 13B remain in Phase 3 as documents that were written and delivered.
Workflow blocker, not data volume. No path to getting CVs into the tool. Revival trigger is CV ingestion.

key_decisions.decision: Data hygiene moves into Zoho, not a PiP tool (31 Jul, decisions 129-130)
key_decisions.rationale: Shalini: 'Why create it in a different tool? That's the bulb.' Three months, mandatory fields from 1 Aug, weekly audit. Framed as IT hygiene with no AI objective attached.

key_decisions.decision: Sourcing Assistant recall simplified to two routes (31 Jul, decisions 131-132)
key_decisions.rationale: Client name + position, OR search ID. Reverses decisions 62, 64, 65. Cause is choice load, not function — every removed field worked as specified.

key_decisions.decision: Revenue/growth picklists accepted; geography stays mandatory as is (31 Jul, decisions 133-134)
key_decisions.rationale: Closes rows 52 and 70. Geography kept because headquarters-in-location is the signal Shalini wants; relocation resistance is the real constraint.

key_decisions.decision: Cadence changed to email, not meetings (31 Jul, decision 138)
key_decisions.rationale: Amit: 'put it in an email to me with sharp points.' Efficient, and also distance — recorded as a decision rather than a drift.

key_decisions.decision: Ishwa never mints a Zoho ID (30 Jul, decision 120)
key_decisions.rationale: Zoho IDs arrive in a datasheet that pre-populates the mandate. When one is traced, an Ishwa UID is minted alongside it; both columns already exist. No Zoho ID means an Ishwa record is created and work proceeds. Supersedes the 17-digit creation gate shipped hours earlier.

key_decisions.decision: Pill weights left flat for the demo (30 Jul, decision 118)
key_decisions.rationale: Prominence is derived from tagging, so it cannot exist before tagging. Seeding opening weights would put a guess into the column the engine later calibrates on.

key_decisions.decision: Scopes declared by hand, never inferred (30 Jul, decision 114)
key_decisions.rationale: Apps Script infers coarsely — touching DriveApp at all infers all-of-Drive. Bound script plus a hand-written oauthScopes array is the project standard for every new backend.

key_decisions.decision: Fresh-build pivot — live capture over ~6 months, no retrospective back-fill
key_decisions.rationale: Confirmed with Shalini/Somanshu 17 Jul. Six-month horizon accepted. Queue form retired.
